attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Nevada state income tax using hypothetical progressive tax brackets: 2.5% on first bracket, 4.0% on second bracket, 6.0% on third bracket. Thresholds vary by filing status. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($7,500 Single, $15,000 MFJ, $11,250 HOH), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.
